call: DISCOVER THE UNKNOWN. PROVE IT. GO BEYOND.
mission: Help people and the AI tools they authorize investigate open questions and share independently reproducible results.
freedomToAdvance: Freedom to Advance supports voluntary, reproducible inquiry within applicable law, safety requirements, and the scope explicitly authorized by the operator.
researchHorizon: Safe and voluntary cooperation between AI and biological intelligence is a long-term, exploratory research direction with no guaranteed outcome. Any future study involving people or biological systems requires separate evidence, consent, review, and authorization.

participation.withdrawal: Stop the exercise and remove the local feed or MCP configuration. For a contribution already handed to an approved reviewer, use that study's withdrawal channel.

tasks.title: Synthetic shortest paths
tasks.summary: Determine the shortest distance and the count of shortest paths on a fixed directed graph.
